mapper.select: SELECT uh.id, uh.user_id AS userId, uh.apt_seq AS aptSeq, hi.apt_nm AS aptName, CONCAT( COALESCE(dc.sido_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(dc.gugun_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(dc.dong_name, '') ) AS address, uh.pyung AS pyung, hi.avg_price AS dealAmount, hi.latitude AS latitude, hi.longitude AS longitude, uh.created_at AS createdAt FROM user_houses uh LEFT JOIN houseinfos hi ON uh.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq LEFT JOIN dongcodes dc ON hi.dong_code = dc.dong_code WHERE uh.user_id = #{userId} AND uh.ownership_type = 'INTEREST' ORDER BY uh.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_houses (user_id, apt_seq, pyung, ownership_type, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{aptSeq}, #{pyung}, 'INTEREST', NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_houses WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND ownership_type = 'INTEREST'
DELETE FROM user_houses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND apt_seq = #{aptSeq} AND ownership_type = 'INTEREST'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_houses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND apt_seq = #{aptSeq} AND ownership_type = 'INTEREST' )
